scope: Read-only CI/release-route assessment; no remote writes, workflow starts, installations or secret inspection.
branch_name_note: The 0.7 fragment is an existing workflow routing prefix, not a requirement to downgrade the app version.
unchanged_workflow_release_route: Publish the reviewed candidate source as a new testupdate-prefix branch and verify exact workflow head SHA.
Require current Development checks, Windows artifacts and unsigned iPhone release proof for that candidate.
After release integration is concrete and reviewed, put that source in codex/smartplan-office-0.2; rerun checks if the integration commit differs.
Dispatch iPhone TestFlight on codex/smartplan-office-0.2 with upload_to_testflight=true and an admissible build number.
Validate matching release manifests and install through the existing TestFlight group; perform real target-device checks.

signed_candidate_branch_alternative.minimum_for_recommended_prefix_branch: Extend only the testflight job's exact-branch condition to additionally allow the one explicit reviewed candidate branch, preserving workflow_dispatch, upload_to_testflight and needs: unsigned. The unsigned routing already allows the recommended prefix.
signed_candidate_branch_alternative.limitation: This is a workflow authorization change for the Apple-secret-bearing job and must be included in the concrete reviewed candidate; do not replace the exact branch gate with unrestricted all-branch signing.

trigger_capabilities.connector_readiness: Parent verified authenticated repository read/write metadata. No mutation was attempted here.
trigger_capabilities.cli_readiness: Parent's ordinary gh auth status reported invalid GH_TOKEN; no usable CLI dispatch authentication has been demonstrated.
important_limits: create_branch requires an existing remote commit SHA/ref; a local-only SHA cannot be used.
Git Data API-created commits can have different identities from local commits; compare exact tree/content and retest the actual remote candidate SHA.
After a real candidate push/ref publication, verify actual triggered runs and head SHA; merely creating a ref or rerunning an old job is not proof of a new candidate build.
Generic GitHub fetch is GET-only and cannot perform workflow dispatch.
Existing rerun tools rerun their original workflow commit and do not select a new candidate.
Normal manual dispatch remains available through GitHub Actions UI; authenticated gh workflow run can be used once ordinary authentication works.
not_executed_cli_examples: gh workflow run ios-testflight.yml --repo smartplanhofmann-spec/Smarplan-Hofmann-Workspace --ref codex/testupdate-0.7-projects-20261104 -F upload_to_testflight=false
gh workflow run ios-testflight.yml --repo smartplanhofmann-spec/Smarplan-Hofmann-Workspace --ref codex/smartplan-office-0.2 -F upload_to_testflight=true

build_number.rule: Explicit build_number, otherwise github.run_number+100; numeric and >= app/pubspec.yaml source build number.
build_number.default_number_implication: The next run at 30 would produce 130 and satisfy current minimum 120. Re-evaluate against the actual final source build number and already uploaded TestFlight builds; concurrent runs can advance numbering.

remaining_boundaries: Current candidate is not yet remote or built.
No current Apple key validity, App Store Connect state, target-device installation, or server deployment verified.
A signed IPA artifact requires the existing signed job; Windows plus unsigned iOS checks alone do not finish iPhone delivery.
